item.title: No Prep Sight Word Worksheets: Read, Trace, Write and Build High Frequency Words
item.description: No prep sight word worksheets for morning work, literacy centres and homework. Each page practises one high frequency word: handwriting lines for tracing and writing, a find-the-word row, a short sentence and cut-and-glue letters to build the word. For kindergarten and 1st grade.
